en_us: The kid's right... this kind of does look a bit like that TV show.
zh: 那孩子说得没错……这儿确实有点像那个电视节目。

en_us: I mean, not that I watched it a lot or anything.
zh: 我是说，我也不是经常看啦。

en_us: Anyway, uhh, sorry. What should I do?
zh: 总之，呃，抱歉。我该做什么？

en_us: Hey, I didn't know you were exploring, too!
zh: 嘿，我不知道你也在四处探索！

en_us: Okay, let's get out of this place!
zh: 好吧，我们离开这个地方！

en_us: Your training experience with alien weaponry has made you a Xenotech Expert.
zh: 你在外星武器方面的训练经历使你成为了异星科技专家。

en_us: An examination of the device shows that it will burn out after 1 more use.
zh: 检查该装置后发现，它再使用 1 次就会烧毁。

en_us: The archway has burned out and is no longer useful.
zh: 拱门已经烧毁，不再有用。

en_us: The archway has restored some of your health.
zh: 拱门恢复了你的一部分生命值。

en_us: An examination of the device shows that it will burn out after %.0f more uses.
zh: 检查该装置后发现，它再使用 %.0f 次就会烧毁。
